boundaries: This receipt pair proves that the ledger recorded a payment entry and a delivery entry bound to each other and to the named artifact digests. It does not prove the payment itself occurred: the payment entry is the operator's record of a provider event, and its truth rests on the upstream webhook/readback verification.
recordedAt is producer-reported and is NOT a trusted timestamp.
Digests attest to bytes at recording time only: the delivered artifact is the byte string whose SHA-256 is recorded, nothing more.
Receipts are hash-bound, not signed. Authenticity of the ledger rests on publication of its chain head; no certification of any kind is made or implied.
